exercises.why: **провожало** — провожа́ть (imperfective): to escort, to accompany, to see off. Wiktionary: проводи́ть + -а́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to take, to bring, to lead
to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: завести́ — to take, to bring, to lead; довести́ — to lead, to take, to accompany (to), to bring (into); сопровожда́ть — to accompany; свести́ — to lead, to take (from somewhere).
**сопровождал** — сопровожда́ть (imperfective): to accompany; to attend, to escort, to convoy. Wiktionary: со- + провождать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to take along, to bring; to conduct
to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́вод — withdrawal; развести́ — to take along, to bring; to conduct; переводи́ть — to lead, to convey, to transfer, to move, to shift, to transmit, to switch; заведе́ние — institution, establishment.
**развёл** — развести́ (perfective): to take along, to bring; to conduct; to part, to move apart, to pull apart, to separate; to dilute, to mix; to dissolve. Wiktionary: раз- + вести́.
